en.name: Sabinian
en.summary: A pope whose unpopular grain-hoarding during famine made him so disliked that Rome reportedly rioted at news of his death.
en.body: Sabinian, who had served as Gregory the Great's envoy to Constantinople, reversed several of his popular predecessor's charitable policies, notably reintroducing the sale rather than free distribution of grain during a time of shortage. His unpopularity was such that later tradition held the Roman populace celebrated rather than mourned his death, and his funeral procession reportedly had to be rerouted to avoid hostile crowds.
